## Notes

ST Nucleo-F767ZI (STM32F767ZI, Cortex-M7F, 384 KiB sram0) on Zephyr 3.7. Renode twin booted the C talker over serial (USART3, the ST-LINK VCP) and ethernet (phase-524 W1). The serial image needs `[image.<id>.knobs.zenoh] max_large_subscribers = 0` stated per image until descriptor `[knobs]` can carry it (see the descriptor header).

See [Board Support Levels](../board-support-levels.md) for what each status means.
